intro: Extract PDF pages copies the pages you choose into a new document and leaves the original untouched. It is what you need to send only the signed page of a contract, pull a chapter out of a manual or separate one invoice from a statement full of them. Pages are copied without recompression, with selectable text and their original quality.

List the pages with numbers and spans separated by commas, such as “1-5, 8, 11-13”, an open span such as “20-”, or the words “even” and “odd”. The new PDF follows the order you type: with “9, 1-3”, page 9 becomes the first one. If a page appears twice in the list, it is copied only once.

For the output you choose between a single PDF with every extracted page, named like the original with “-extracto” at the end, or one PDF per page, numbered with each page's position. In the second case you download the files one by one or all together in a ZIP.
It all happens in your browser, with nothing uploaded to any server. If you choose several PDFs, the same pages are extracted from each one.

faq.q: How is this different from Split PDF?
faq.a: Extract takes only the pages you ask for and leaves out the rest. Split shares the whole document out into parts: by page count, bookmarks, size or blank pages.

faq.q: Are the numbers the ones printed on the page?
faq.a: No: it counts the position in the file, starting at 1. If the document has an unnumbered cover, printed page “1” may be the second page of the file.
Yes, each page's annotations travel with it. The original document's bookmarks, however, are not copied to the new PDF.
